content:
Let \(P\) be the number of purple balls.

To guarantee getting one blue and one yellow ball in the worst case, you could draw all purple balls and all 11 yellow balls first. Then the next draw must be blue:

\[
P + 11 + 1 = P + 12
\]

This is given as 19, so:

\[
P + 12 = 19 \implies P = 7
\]

\boxed{7}
